name: Boffzen (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, yellow and red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Boffzen (red and white with crosses, a wavy pale and a sheaf).
history: Municipal flag of Boffzen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Boffzen arms — crosses, wavy pale and sheaf
